name: io.github.gocutover/cutover-mcp
title: Cutover
description: Query and manage Cutover runbooks, tasks, streams, workspaces and teams through the Cutover API.

environmentVariables.name: CUTOVER_CORE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your Cutover instance URL, e.g. https://YOUR-INSTANCE-NAME.cutover.com

environmentVariables.name: CUTOVER_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A Cutover user app token (My Details > User App Tokens, or issued by an admin via Access Management)

environmentVariables.name: CUTOVER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Cutover API host. Defaults to https://api.cutover.net; set it only for an instance with its own API host, e.g. https://api.YOUR-INSTANCE-NAME.cutover.com
